header.title: ProgressBar
header.description: Linear progress bar. With `value` it shows how far a task has gone (0 to 100 by default) and with `isIndeterminate` it signals that something is running without knowing how long it will take. Adds a label, a value, an indicator at the edge of the fill and seven tones. `Progress` is an alias of the same component.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props to see the bar and the code.
playground.label: Uploading report

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: `value` fills the bar. If there's no visible `label`, pass `aria-label` so the bar has a name.

determinate.title: Determinate
determinate.description: `label` shows text above the bar and names it. `showValue` adds the value on the right: with `max` at 100 and an integer, it's shown as a percentage.

indeterminate.title: Indeterminate
indeterminate.description: `isIndeterminate` animates a segment across the bar. Use it when you don't know how much is left. `value`, `showValue` and the indicator are ignored.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` changes the height: `sm`, `md` (default) and `lg`. It also adjusts the text and the indicator.

radius.title: Radius
radius.description: `radius` rounds the bar and the fill: `sm`, `md`, `lg` or `full` (default).

tones.title: Tones
tones.description: `tone` sets the fill color: `primary` (default), `secondary`, `success`, `warning`, `error`, `info` or `neutral`. Don't rely on color alone to convey a state: pair it with text.

loadPosition.title: Direction
loadPosition.description: `loadPosition` picks where the fill grows from: `right` (default) grows left to right and `left` grows right to left.

thumb.title: Indicator
thumb.description: `showThumb` adds a circle at the edge of the fill. `thumbIcon` replaces it with an icon: a component receives `size` based on the bar size; an element is used as is.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: `disabled` (or `isDisabled`) dims the bar, turns it gray and stops the indeterminate animation. Useful for a paused process.

customValue.title: Custom value
customValue.description: `min` and `max` change the range. `formatValue` builds the visible text and the one screen readers read. `valueLabel` only changes the visible text: also pass `aria-valuetext` with the same data.

live.title: Live
live.description: The fill and the indicator animate when `value` changes. In this example, pausing uses `disabled` to show the state.

upload.title: Upload flow
upload.description: A full case: indeterminate while preparing, then determinate, and when done it switches to `success` with an icon. The bar doesn't announce completion by itself, so the example shows a toast.

threshold.title: Thresholds
threshold.description: Change `tone` based on the value to warn when something approaches its limit. In this example: `success` below 70, `warning` from 70 and `error` from 90.

alias.title: Progress alias
alias.description: `Progress` is the same component as `ProgressBar`, with the same props.

header.title: ProgressBar API
header.description: API reference for the ProgressBar React component: props, CSS classes, variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demos page.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from the main entry or from its subpath. `Progress` is an alias with the same props.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts <div> attributes except children, and they go to the container along with ref, id and className. The exceptions are role, aria-label, aria-labelledby and aria-valuetext, which go to the bar (the element with role="progressbar"). classNames adds classes to root, header, label, value, track, fill and thumb.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.role: The bar has role="progressbar" with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-valuenow. The value is clamped between min and max.
a11y.name: With label, the bar is named through aria-labelledby and aria-label is ignored. Without a visible label, pass aria-label or aria-labelledby.
a11y.valuetext: aria-valuetext comes from formatValue (or the default format). valueLabel only changes the visible text: pass aria-valuetext with the same data.
a11y.indeterminate: With isIndeterminate the values are removed and aria-busy="true" is added.
a11y.disabled: disabled adds aria-disabled="true". It's visual only: the value stays whatever you pass.
a11y.thumb: The indicator and its icon have aria-hidden.
a11y.live: Value changes aren't announced automatically. To report completion, use a toast or a region with role="status".
a11y.motion: With prefers-reduced-motion transitions are removed and the indeterminate animation stays still.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.root: Container. Defines the variables. Receives `className` and `classNames.root`.
rules.withThumb: Applied when the indicator is shown.
rules.label: Label. Receives `classNames.label`.
rules.rail: Wraps the bar and the indicator. Only exists with an indicator and has no `classNames` key.
rules.thumbIconSlot: Indicator with an icon. Paints the icon with `--gem-progress-fill`.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: ProgressBar's own variables. Redefine them in a class on `.gem-progress`; tone and size classes have the same specificity, so use `.gem-progress.your-class` and a `[data-theme="dark"]` variant.

items.--gem-progress-fill: Fill color and indicator border. Set by the tone.
items.--gem-progress-h: Bar height. Set by the size.
items.--gem-progress-thumb-size: Indicator size. Set by the size.

items.--gem-color-{tone}-600: Fill for each tone (`primary`, `secondary`, `success`, `warning`, `error`, `info`). Dark mode uses the palette.
items.--gem-space-2: Gap between the header and the bar.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

items.value: Current value. Clamped between `min` and `max`. Ignored when indeterminate.
items.max: Maximum value. If it isn't greater than `min`, `min + 100` is used.
items.isIndeterminate: Progress with an unknown value. Animates the fill and removes ARIA values.
items.label: Visible text above the bar. Gives it an accessible name.
items.valueLabel: Replaces the value text. Shown even if `showValue` is `false`.
items.formatValue: Formats the visible value and `aria-valuetext`. By default it adds `%` only if `max` is 100 and the value is an integer.
items.loadPosition: Fill direction: `right` grows left to right and `left` the opposite.
items.showThumb: Shows a circle at the edge of the fill. Hidden when indeterminate.
items.thumbIcon: Indicator icon: an element or a component that receives `size`. Takes priority over `showThumb`.
items.disabled: Dims the bar and stops the animation.
items.aria-label: Bar name when there's no `label`. Ignored if there's a `label`.
items.aria-labelledby: Id of an element that names the bar. Combined with the `label` one.
items.aria-valuetext: Value text for screen readers. Overrides the `formatValue` one.
items.id: Container id. Also builds the label id.
